profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary: Software Engineer at Meta with a passion for building impactful software.

positions.title: Senior Consultant Developer
positions.description:
Working as a senior developer and consultant on the Sustainability Solutions team. Serving as core maintainer and developer of Cloud Carbon Footprint, continuing to grow it as a flexible tool for measuring carbon impact of cloud usage, carbon-led rightsizing recommendations, flexible integrations into platforms such as Backstage, and continuous improvement in performance and scalability for enterprise use. Contributing technical articles to the cloudcarbonfootprint.org/blog

Operating as technical anchor for client-facing green software engagements including a leading game developer/publisher, delivering a sophisticated cloud-based solution that aggregated and visualized over 48 million rows of cloud carbon data using a suite of AWS tools. Also led a project for a Finland-based client, developing a Python CLI variant of the CCF formula, ensuring adaptability across diverse infrastructures while consistently upholding the highest standards in code quality, review processes, and pipeline management.

positions.title: Consultant Developer
positions.description:
Working as a developer and consultant on our Cleantech & Sustainability solutions for clients and the IT industry (https://www.thoughtworks.com/about-us/sustainability/sustainability-solutions). This also includes being an advocate for Sustainable UX as well as building and maintaining Cloud Carbon Footprint, an open source tool for individuals and organizations to measure their energy and carbon emissions in the cloud (https://www.cloudcarbonfootprint.org/).

Participated in Thoughtworks University, a rigorous program dedicated to refining skills in consulting and agile development. Worked with a psuedo client to transform business requirements and feedback into a full-fledged e-commerce bicycle platform using JavaScript, React, Java, Spring, and PostgreSQL.

positions.title: Jr. Front End Developer
positions.description: Designed and developed front-end user interfaces for both internal and customer-facing production applications. Included utilizing the Adobe Creative Cloud suite for UI/X design and prototyping new features, working alongside cross-functional Agile-based teams to define and implement project requirements, managing CMS integration and accessibility requirements of production sites, and building design system to be used across projects. This involved working with in .NET MVC projects using C# and Razor, creating user interfaces with React via Typescript/Javascript as a frontend, implementing scalable style systems using CSS/SCSS, and working with Azure pipelines for CI/CD.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Adobe XD · ASP.NET MVC · TypeScript · React.js

positions.title: Technical Training Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed cross-platform templates for online assessments using HTML, CSS, and Javascript
•	Implemented a new WebGL-based application to be utilized in the training of over 500 employees
•	Leading the independent development of a safety training simulation to be used across the company
positions.insights: Skills: WebGL · JavaScript · Unity3D · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML

positions.title: Interactive Developer Intern
positions.description:
•	Chosen as 1 of 2 Fall Interns to assist with the development and delivery of interactive digital products
•	Developed a template and instructions for converting Adobe Flash projects to HTML web applications
•	Employing HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Typescript to deliver 16 products now live for consumer use
•	Tracking product versioning and architecture through bitbucket and Unix terminal environment
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · Adobe Creative Suite · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · TypeScript · Bitbucket

positions.title: Commercial Operations Intern
positions.description:
•	Designing and programming simulations for field employees to practice safety procedures
•	Writing C# scripts for proper simulation functions and features using Microsoft Visual Studio 
•	Utilizing .NET framework to test and develop simulation software for training field employees 
•	Developing simulated environments using the Unity 3D Engine for flexible performance
•	Rotating among departments to expand knowledge of the overarching business and its interdependency
•	Working alongside other rotational interns on management projects regarding employment turnover and external communications

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
•	Display ownership and responsibility for the proper function and experience of the facility
•	Demonstrate organizational skills when preparing event locations
•	Write precise, well-organized emails, letters and proposals while using proper vocabulary and grammar

positions.title: Student Technician
positions.description:
•	Repairing laptop and desktop machines for faculty members and students in a timely manner
•	Troubleshooting software and hardware issues in machines while updating results in ticketing system
•	Removing malfunctioning hardware and manually installing new and functioning components
•	Collaborating  with and shadowing other employees to continuously learn new skills and troubleshooting procedures

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
•	Promoted Manager in less than two months
•	Satisfying customer needs in a timely manner
•	Solving customer complaints and concerns with a positive attitude
•	Training employees and reviewing/interviewing applicants for hire
•	Leading crew throughout shifts
•	Taking inventory and listing it in a clear and efficient manner
•	Prioritizing multiple tasks and developing work chemistry among employees
•	Handling routine maintenance of cafe interior

positions.title: Polymer Envoy
positions.description:
•	Learned how to operate lab machines for polymer engineering projects 
•	Researched polymer engineering breakthroughs in labs regarding Polymer Aerogel and its applications
•	Presented research findings to several universities’ professors, faculty, and students
